##### Project general facts

Terra Golf Collection by Taraf is an exquisite development offering villas and townhouses seamlessly integrated into the lush landscapes of an existing prestigious golf field. The architectural philosophy is rooted in modernist minimalism, creating a harmonious dialogue between sleek geometric lines and the organic beauty of the surrounding greens. Each residence offers stunning uninterrupted views of the lush golf course, embracing a minimalist yet elegant design where the use of neutral colors and essential materials highlights the natural beauty, enhanced by luxurious finishes.

Stand-alone villas offer a bespoke living experience with provisions for a private theatre room, bar, and personal gym which can be designed as per preference and needs, along with a family lounge, sky lounge, terrace, and a private backyard amidst the greens. Twin villas boast luxurious living rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, a sky lounge, family lounge, and a backyard overlooking the greens. Townhouses blend style with functionality, featuring open, well-arranged layouts with large windows to maximize space and natural light, each with a backyard offering direct access to the greenery.

In keeping with the principles of modernist minimalism, the material palette is carefully curated with high-quality, sustainable materials such as glass, steel, and natural renders to create a sense of timelessness. These materials enhance durability while contributing to the overall aesthetic of understated luxury. Each unit features spacious living rooms, bedrooms, dining areas, and bathrooms, with kitchens fully equipped. Every aspect is designed for comfort and spaciousness, featuring panoramic views of the golf course.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Golf Estates, an exclusive and opulent residential and leisure development in the southwestern part of Dubai, this exceptional location is renowned for its world-class golf facilities and opulent living spaces. The heart of the community is its two splendid championship golf courses, meticulously designed by golf legends Greg Norman and Pete Dye, with the Earth Course hosting the prestigious DP World Tour Championship.

The location is distinguished by its wealth of community amenities and facilities, including recreational spaces, fitness centers, and fine dining options, providing residents with a well-rounded and enjoyable lifestyle. The community's lush landscapes and serene environment create a peaceful retreat while remaining conveniently connected to Dubai's key destinations.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modernist elegance, golf-course living, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Golf Estates delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class golf, luxurious living, and a prestigious address makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of refined living.
